newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Jamshoro power plant sale in December.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Jamshoro power plant sale in December.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission said on Sunday the sale of a 26 percent stake in the state-owned 880-megawatt Jamshoro power plant to a strategic investor will be held on time in December.
Salman Shah, the chairman of the Privatisation Commission, told Reuters there would no delay in the sale and transfer of management of the plant to a strategic investor.
However, a bidding date is yet to be announced.
The sale process has been delayed from September due to delay in completion of some technical reports.

Six companies have been short-listed to bid for the power plant that will be the second to be privatised by Pakistan. In June Pakistan handed over management control of the 1,600-MW Kot Addu power plant to Britain's National Power Plc.
